description: A large three-masted sailing ship with a gilded stern and dense rigging is moored at a wooden quay at sunset. Men in dark cloaks and wide-brimmed black hats stand on the dock, one pointing toward the ship, while porters carry sacks and crates of brown dried goods on their shoulders; barrels, sacks and crates are stacked in the foreground. On the right, a stone fort wall with two armoured guards holding pikes or halberds and figures on the battlement, with palms and a hillside behind. The clothing, rigging and fort suggest the early 17th century in a tropical harbour, and no text, frame or gore is visible.
